reply.text: Compound presses first, then isolation for volume — overhead press or incline press for heavy pressing, then lateral raises for the side delt, which is what actually makes shoulders look wider. Rear delt work (face pulls, reverse flyes) matters too and gets skipped a lot. Most people do well with 10-15 hard sets a week across those, progressing load or reps over time. If you want this built into your actual program, say the word and I'll set it up.
